# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/railway
# args: 
Interact with Railway via CLI

Tip: Using an AI coding agent? Run `railway setup agent -y` to install Railway skills and the Railway MCP server.

Usage: railway [COMMAND]

Commands:
  add               Add a service to your project
  agent             Interact with the Railway Agent
  api               Query the Railway public GraphQL API
  autoupdate        Manage auto-update preferences
  bucket            Manage project buckets [aliases: buckets]
  cdn               Manage CDN caching for a service
  ca                Manage Railway cloud agents
  code              Launch a coding agent on a Railway cloud agent VM
  completion        Generate completion script
  config            Manage Railway configuration and IaC ownership
  connect           Connect to a database's shell (psql for Postgres, mongosh for MongoDB, etc.)
  delete            Delete a project [aliases: rm, remove]
  deploy            Provisions a template into your project
  deployment        Manage deployments [aliases: deployments]
  dev               Run Railway services locally [aliases: develop]
  domain            Add, list, inspect, update, or delete domains for a service
  docs              Open Railway Documentation in default browser, or print doc URLs in non-interactive mode
  down              Remove the most recent deployment
  environment       Create, delete or link an environment [aliases: env]
  flag              Manage feature flags [aliases: flags]
  init              Create a new project [aliases: new]
  link              Associate existing project with current directory, may specify projectId as an argument
  list              List all projects in your Railway account [aliases: ls]
  login             Sign in to Railway — also creates a new account if you don't have one
  logout            Logout of your Railway account
  logs              View build, deploy, HTTP, network flow, or DNS logs
  mcp               Connects AI agents to Railway's MCP server, or installs the MCP config into AI coding tools
  metrics           View resource and HTTP metrics for a Railway service
  open              Open your project dashboard
  outbound-network  Manage outbound networking for a service
  mysql             Manage MySQL features: high availability
  postgres          Manage Postgres features: point-in-time recovery, high availability, and connection pooling
  project           Manage projects [aliases: projects]
  private-network   Manage private networking for a service
  run               Run a local command using variables from the active environment [aliases: local]
  sandbox           Manage ephemeral sandboxes [aliases: sandboxes, sbx]
  service           Manage services
  setup             Set up your editor for Railway agent functionality (skills, MCP, login)
  shell             Open a local subshell with Railway variables available
  skills            Install Railway agent skills for AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Factory Droid, Pi, and all tools that support .agents/skills)
  ssh               Connect to a service via SSH or manage SSH keys
  status            Show information about a Railway project
  telemetry_cmd     Manage telemetry preferences [aliases: telemetry]
  templates         Discover Railway templates [aliases: template]
  tcp-proxy         Manage public TCP proxies for a service
  unlink            Disassociate project from current directory
  up                Upload and deploy project from the current directory
  upgrade           Upgrade the Railway CLI to the latest version. Use `--yes` for non-interactive agent/script usage
  usage             Show workspace usage and manage usage limits
  variable          Manage environment variables for a service [aliases: variables, vars, var]
  waf               Manage WAF settings for a service
  whoami            Get the current logged in user
  volume            Manage project volumes [aliases: volumes]
  redeploy          Redeploy the latest deployment of a service
  redis             Manage Redis features: high availability
  restart           Restart the latest deployment of a service (without rebuilding)
  scale             
  check_updates     Test the update check [aliases: check-updates]
  functions         Manage project functions [aliases: function, func, fn, funcs, fns]
  help              Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
